name: shiny-feature-patterns
description: Patterns for adding interactive features to modular Shiny apps: extracting H5AD .obs data for new UI controls, conditional renderUI with graceful fallback, embedded vs modal segmentation panels, grouped selectInput choices, multi-row heatmaps. Trigger: (1) adding new data-driven filters/selectors to Shiny modules, (2) exposing hidden H5AD .obs columns in UI, (3) replacing modal dialogs with embedded panels, (4) adding multi-feature heatmaps or z-scored visualizations.
